sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:37396
Court No. - 16

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14976 of 2023
Applicant :- Mithun Alias Mithun Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Affairs, Govt.
U.P. Luckno

Counsel for Applicant :- Naveen Chandra Upadhyay
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Chandrika Rani Upadhyay,Satyam Pandey,Tripuresh Mishr
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.

Heard Shri Naveen Chandra Upadhyay, learned counsel for the accused/applicant as well as
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  This second bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Mithun Alias Mithun Kumar for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 269/2022, under Sections 354, 376-D, 506 of IPC and under Section 5 (g)/6 of POCSO Act,2012, Police Station Khairi Ghat, District Bahraich, during trial.
As his first bail application has been dismissed as not pressed by this Court, vide order dated 24.07.2023 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.10304 of 2022.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.10304 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that it is a case of false implication.

The alleged incident of rape is shown to have occurred on 11.6.2022 and the FIR of this case has been lodged after delay of 08 days on 19.6.2022 and no explanation of such huge delay has been given either in the FIR or in the statement of complainant or victim.

sentences.text: 1 4. It is vehemently submitted that the story as cooked up by the prosecution may not be believed on the touch stone of probability as it is shown that there was a marriage ceremony in the village and therefore it may not be presumed that the accused persons have found a lonely place for committing sexual assault on the victim.

5. It is further submitted that the mother of the prosecutrix/ victim has also claimed herself to be an eye witness and she has not alleged commission of rape to the applicant and the role of only filming a video has been assigned to him.
6. It is further submitted that during the course of investigation no video has seen from any where.

Identically placed co-accused persons, namely, Nunan @ Munan @ Pramod Kumar has been granted bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court as well as Amarjeet, vide orders dated 8.1.2024 and 28.1.2023 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application Nos. 11309 of 2022 and 11085 of 2022, respectively.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application Nos. 11309 of 2022 and 11085 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 7. It is further submitted that the applicant is not having any criminal antecedent and there is no apprehension that the accused-applicant after release on bail, may flee from the process of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
The applicant is in jail in this case since 21.6.2022.

8. Learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel appearing for complainant/ informant vehemently opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the round that the factum of rape has been fortified by the prosecutrix in her statement recorded Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. wherein the role of commission of rape has been assigned to the instant applicant, thus he is not entitled to be released on bail.

9. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that this is the second bail application moved on behalf of applicant, as his first bail application has been dismissed as not pressed by this Court on 24.07.2023, thus the same was not dismissed on merits.

It is also transpired that the victim has lodged the FIR of the instant case and has supported the allegation of rape under Sectiosn161 and 164 Cr.P.C. the Victim could only be medically examined on 23.6.2022 i.e. about 12 days after the incident, no abnormality or any injury etc. has been found on the person of the prosecutrix/ victim.
The age of the victim has been assessed as 16 years both on the basis of of educational credentials and on the basis of ossification test.
Identically placed co-accused person, namely, Nunan @ Munan @ Pramod Kumar has been granted bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court on 8.1.2024.
Nothing has been brought before this Court which may suggest that the said order has been challenged at any higher forum or has been cancelled by the same Court.
The applicant is in jail in this case since 21.06.2022 and he is not having any criminal history.
His presence may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.
10. Thus having regard to all the facts and circumstances of the case and also on the principle of parity, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
The bail application moved on behalf of the applicant is thus allowed.

11. Let the applicant-Mithun Alias Mithun Kumar involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court Mithun Alias Mithun Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181122746/
2 concerned subject to following conditions:-

entities.text: Mithun Alias Mithun Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ( i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
13. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
14. Observations made herein-above are only for the purpose of disposal of bail application and the same shall not have any bearing on the trial of the case.
